Globals require a template set, as template functions do.
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- shared/globals.go --
package shared

import "context"

//fabrik:templates:global
func Greeting(ctx context.Context) string { return "hi" }
-- want/diags --
error: shared/globals.go:5:1: //fabrik:templates:global without any //fabrik:templates declaration
  help: declare a template set the global can be parsed into
